prior_workflow:
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      phase22_historical:
        description: Run only the approved Phase 22 development batch and historical pair
        type: boolean
        default: false
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  phase20-offline:
    if: ${{ !inputs.phase22_historical }}
    name: Phase 20 ${{ matrix.treatment }} verification
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        treatment: [rules, replay]
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e # v6
        with:
          version: 0.8.22
      - name: Install locked development dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12
      - name: Validate corpus and retained comparator metadata offline
        run: uv run python -m scripts.run_phase20_benchmark validate
      - name: Check out the measured scanner and harness for baseline reproduction
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          ref: 8824014e961722980757bb589009dc59b78d9a37
          path: .phase20-scanner
      - name: Restore the versioned accepted captures and ledger
        run: cp -R artifacts/phase20/completion-v2/captures/. .phase20-scanner/artifacts/phase20/captures/
      - name: Install the frozen baseline environment
        working-directory: .phase20-scanner
        run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12
      - name: Verify the full corpus without paid calls
        working-directory: .phase20-scanner
        run: uv run python -m scripts.run_phase20_benchmark ${{ matrix.treatment }} --output "${{ runner.temp }}/phase20-${{ matrix.treatment }}" --compare-to ../artifacts/phase20/completion-v2/${{ matrix.treatment }}
      - name: Retain offline verification evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: phase20-${{ matrix.treatment }}-verification
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/phase20-${{ matrix.treatment }}

  quality:
    if: ${{ !inputs.phase22_historical }}
    name: Quality (${{ matrix.os }}, Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e # v6
        with:
          version: 0.8.22
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Verify lockfile
        run: uv lock --check

      - name: Lint
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} ruff check .

      - name: Check formatting
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} ruff format --check .

      - name: Type check
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} mypy

      - name: Check generated schemas
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} python -m sentinel.schema check

      - name: Check judge artifacts
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} python -m scripts.generate_phase5_artifacts --check

      - name: Check generated third-party notices
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && matrix.python-version == '3.12'
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} python scripts/generate_third_party_notices.py --check

      - name: Test with branch coverage
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} pytest

      - name: Exercise public pre-commit hook
        run: >-
          uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} python
          scripts/smoke_pre_commit.py

      - name: Plan GPT smoke without credentials or network
        run: >-
          uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} python
          scripts/capture_gpt_reviews.py smoke

      - name: Plan Phase 12 GPT smoke without credentials or network
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && matrix.python-version == '3.12'
        run: >-
          uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} python
          scripts/capture_gpt_reviews.py phase12-smoke

      - name: Audit locked runtime dependencies
        run: |
          uv export --locked --no-dev --no-editable --no-emit-project --format requirements-txt --output-file "${{ runner.temp }}/runtime-requirements.txt"
          uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} pip-audit --no-deps --disable-pip -r "${{ runner.temp }}/runtime-requirements.txt"

  build-wheel:
    if: ${{ !inputs.phase22_historical }}
    name: Build canonical distributions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e # v6
        with:
          version: 0.8.22
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Build wheel and source distribution
        run: uv build

      - name: Upload canonical distributions
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: portunusmcp-sentinel-dist
          path: |
            dist/*.whl
            dist/*.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

  distribution:
    if: ${{ !inputs.phase22_historical }}
    name: Wheel (${{ matrix.os }}, Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: build-wheel
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Download canonical distributions
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: portunusmcp-sentinel-dist
          path: dist

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e # v6
        with:
          version: 0.8.22
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install pipx
        run: python -m pip install pipx==1.16.0

      - name: Smoke-test distributions through pip, pipx, and uv
        run: python scripts/smoke_wheel.py artifacts dist

  docker-demo:
    if: ${{ !inputs.phase22_historical }}
    name: Installed-wheel Docker replay
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-wheel

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Download canonical wheel
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: portunusmcp-sentinel-dist
          path: dist

      - name: Install canonical wheel
        run: python -m pip install dist/*.whl

      - name: Run packaged replay demo
        run: sentinel demo --replay-review --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/sentinel-demo-results"

      - name: Run generated configuration through Docker
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ""
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cp -R tests/fixtures/clean_server "${{ runner.temp }}/onboarding-target"
          rm "${{ runner.temp }}/onboarding-target/sentinel.target.yaml"
          rm "${{ runner.temp }}/onboarding-target/sentinel.permissions.yaml"
          cd "${{ runner.temp }}/onboarding-target"
          sentinel init --dynamic
          # The fixture needs semantically valid inputs beyond its JSON schema.
          python - <<'PY'
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import yaml
          target = Path("sentinel.target.yaml")
          configuration = yaml.safe_load(target.read_text())
          reference = Path(os.environ["GITHUB_WORKSPACE"]) / "tests/fixtures/clean_server/sentinel.target.yaml"
          configuration["probe_baselines"] = yaml.safe_load(reference.read_text())["probe_baselines"]
          target.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(configuration, sort_keys=False))
          PY
          sentinel scan .

      - name: Exercise installed-wheel full baseline workflow
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ""
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cp -R tests/fixtures/vulnerable_server "${{ runner.temp }}/baseline-target"
          cd "${{ runner.temp }}/baseline-target"
          set +e
          sentinel scan . --allow-degraded --format json --output sentinel-baseline.json
          initial_exit=$?
          set -e
          test "$initial_exit" -eq 1
          sentinel scan . --allow-degraded --baseline sentinel-baseline.json --format json --output "${{ runner.temp }}/baseline-unchanged.json"
          echo 'phase12_token = "ghp_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz1234567890"' >> server.py
          set +e
          sentinel scan . --allow-degraded --baseline sentinel-baseline.json --format json --output "${{ runner.temp }}/baseline-changed.json"
          changed_exit=$?
          set -e
          test "$changed_exit" -eq 1

      - name: Validate installed-wheel demo reports
        run: |
          python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; from sentinel.report.validate_json import validate_report_data; validate_report_data(json.loads(Path(r'${{ runner.temp }}/sentinel-demo-results/report.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))"
          python -m sentinel.report.validate_sarif "${{ runner.temp }}/sentinel-demo-results/report.sarif"

  rules-only-isolation:
    if: ${{ !inputs.phase22_historical }}
    name: Installed-wheel rules-only network isolation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-wheel
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Download canonical wheel
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: portunusmcp-sentinel-dist
          path: dist
      - name: Install dependencies before isolation
        run: |
          python -m venv "${{ runner.temp }}/offline-venv"
          "${{ runner.temp }}/offline-venv/bin/python" -m pip install dist/*.whl
      - name: Require scans inside an isolated Linux network namespace
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          sudo unshare --net -- "${{ runner.temp }}/offline-venv/bin/python" scripts/smoke_wheel.py offline "${{ runner.temp }}/offline-venv/bin" 2>&1 | tee "${{ runner.temp }}/rules-only-isolation.log"
      - name: Retain isolation log
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: rules-only-isolation-log
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rules-only-isolation.log
          if-no-files-found: error

  phase22-historical-final:
    name: Approved Phase 22 development and historical checks
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.phase22_historical && github.ref == 'refs/heads/phase22/integration' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 240
    env:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ""
      PYTHONPATH: src:.
    steps:
      - name: Check out the approved measurement files
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Preserve the exact approval and gate files
        run: cp -R artifacts/phase22/integration/v9-native-runner-approved-v1 "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-approval"
      - name: Check out the immutable detector and existing harness
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5
        with:
          ref: 7555a9d3b472516ea880bd0ba8fbd25e89699453
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e
        with:
          version: 0.8.22
      - name: Install locked development dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12
      - name: Record the execution environment
        env:
          MEASUREMENT_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-final-historical
        run: |
          uv run python - <<'PYCODE'
          import importlib.metadata,json,os,platform,subprocess,sys
          from pathlib import Path
          from scripts.phase20_measurements import scanner_identity
          root=Path(os.environ['MEASUREMENT_ROOT']);root.mkdir()
          record={'source':scanner_identity(),'python':sys.version,'platform':platform.platform(),'cpu_count':os.cpu_count(),'loadavg':os.getloadavg(),'meminfo':Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text(),'semgrep':importlib.metadata.version('semgrep'),'packages':sorted(f"{d.metadata['Name']}=={d.version}" for d in importlib.metadata.distributions()),'workflow_run':os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']}
          (root/'environment.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
          PYCODE
      - name: Entire original development batch and gate
        env:
          DEVELOPMENT_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-final-historical/development
        run: |
          uv run python - <<'PYCODE'
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          from scripts.phase22_corpus import frozen
          from scripts.phase20_measurements import measure
          manifest=frozen();selected=[i for i in manifest.inputs if i.split=='development'];assert len(selected)==25
          measure(manifest.model_copy(update={'inputs':selected}),'rules',Path(os.environ['DEVELOPMENT_OUTPUT']))
          PYCODE
          uv run python "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-approval/development-gate.py" "$DEVELOPMENT_OUTPUT" "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-approval"
      - name: First entire native historical batch and gate
        run: |
          uv run python -m scripts.run_phase20_benchmark rules --output "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-final-historical/first"
          uv run python "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-approval/gate.py" "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-final-historical/first" "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-approval"
      - name: Second entire native historical batch and gate
        run: |
          uv run python -m scripts.run_phase20_benchmark rules --output "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-final-historical/second" --compare-to "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-final-historical/first"
          uv run python "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-approval/gate.py" "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-final-historical/second" "${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-approval"
      - name: Retain every result, including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: phase22-final-historical
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/phase22-final-historical
          if-no-files-found: error
